newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.934 billion yuan from 1.514 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was more active than Wednesday with some short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, seen borrowing actively, traders said.
"The short-term financial centres borrowed heavily on increased fund demand with the approach of the summer harvest season," one traders said.
"The centres from grain-producing provinces such as Jiangxi and Hubei were the most active borrowers," he said.
The Agriculture Bank of China, which ususally increases its money supply during harvest seasons, was the biggest lender, traders said.
Traders said they believed the summer harvest season would continue to support interbank trading in the next few days.
